entries.en: to hold; to depend on, to rest with
entries.notes: L 栏 puma/numa 读法未定且释义止于 depender del-，M 仅存 Ty-，义依 H 持 及残义定。

entries.zh: 持守、守住；遵循（所倚赖者）
entries.en: to keep, to hold fast; to observe (a rule)
entries.notes: L 栏 numma/puma 读法存疑，H 持守 与 M ty siû 密合，义从汉字定。

entries.en: to stand at someone's side; to attend beside
to be alone, by oneself
entries.notes: H 特 与 M Tè 对音不合「特」之常读，依 L estar solo 与「特」之单、独义定。

entries.en: to guard the harbor mouth; to be at the port entrance
entries.notes: M 首音节调符污损（T99），L 后半 ella bravon- 亦残，义依 港 字与 boca del puerto 定。

entries.en: a maiden, an unmarried virgin
for the time being, temporarily; to be just passing through
entries.notes: H 第二字 權/榷 未定，M cuān 支持「權」，义从 de passo 之暂时、路过义。

entries.zh: 薰化、受感化（L 栏讹误严重，语义存疑）
entries.en: to be influenced or swayed (Spanish corrupt; reading uncertain)
entries.notes: L sobre symo se goja lle uar de otro pander, o sell pasion 讹误难读，H 淨化 与 M hūn hùa 疑即「薰化」，故降级。

entries.en: to be on the alert, to keep one's mind fixed within
entries.notes: L 之 capo 疑为 cabo 之讹，sobre aviso 即警醒留意；H 神在心內落 系逐字对译。

entries.en: to be at home, to stay in the house
entries.notes: H 帶 为 蹛（tòa，居住）之同音借字，非「携带」义。

entries.en: up above, in the sky; in heaven
entries.notes: H 为逐字对译（在／那／顶／处），M 首字 tù 与「在」之常读不合，义依 L en el cielo 定。

entries.zh: 单脚独立（如鹤独立，长短脚）
entries.en: to stand on one leg, like a crane

entries.zh: 单脚站立、立着如鹤独立
entries.en: to be standing on one leg, like a crane
on both sides, to left and right
this (demonstrative pronoun)
entries.notes: R 栏仅存 ne. 不成音节，与「只」官话读音不合，疑栏位残；义依 L Este, esta, esto 与 M chý 定。

entries.en: this time, at present
the season, the times
nowadays, at present
this world, this life
this year
